company.shortDescription: Edyst is an early stage online learning & employability startup for aspiring software developers.
company.description:
Edyst is an early stage online learning & employability startup for aspiring software developers. Their solutions aim to make students learn the most in-demand technical skills needed by the industry, keep them immersed and addicted to the learning process and connect them to prospective employers.

Edyst was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
